AgentStep.description:
One tool call of the verdict agent, as logged in `verdict.agent_step`.

A call to a tool the agent does not have is a step too (owner,
2026-10-08): `tool` is then null, `asked_tool` is the name the model
asked for, and the step is refused. Its arguments are not kept: they
are of no known shape.
AgentStep.title: AgentStep

AgentStepList.description:
Response of both agent log reads: the steps in the order they were made.

Within a run by step number; across the runs of a case, run after run.
The answer is bounded: `has_more` says that more steps exist than are
listed; they are read by asking again with the last step listed as the
cursor.
AgentStepList.title: AgentStepList

AgentStepQuery.description:
Query of `GET /cases/{case_id}/agent-steps?tool=&rule_id=`; every field is optional.

The cursor names the last step seen. A case's steps span its runs, and a
step number is one run's own, so the cursor is that step's run and its
number, given together.
AgentStepQuery.title: AgentStepQuery

AuditRecord.description: One row of the audit trail; `workflow` is the only writer.
AuditRecord.title: AuditRecord

AuditTrail.description:
Response of `GET /cases/{case_id}/audit`: the case's events, oldest first.

The order is the one `workflow` recorded the events in, so a cause never
comes after its effect, whatever the clocks of the services that set
`occurred_at` say. The answer is bounded: it holds the first events, and
`has_more` says that the case has more than are listed.
AuditTrail.title: AuditTrail

CaseCreated.description: Response of `POST /cases`; the request body is the PDF itself.
CaseCreated.title: CaseCreated

CaseList.description:
Response of `GET /cases`: the cases, newest started first.

Cases that belong to an eval run are left out. The answer is bounded:
`has_more` says that more cases exist than are listed.
CaseList.title: CaseList

CaseStarted.description: Response of `POST /cases/{case_id}/start`: the case as it was actually started.
CaseStarted.title: CaseStarted

CaseSummary.description: One case in the underwriter's list.
CaseSummary.title: CaseSummary

Classification.description: One classifier's reading of one page; it never carries a route (AD-7).
Classification.title: Classification

ClassificationScoreboard.description: The file `classification.json`: both classifier contenders, scored on the same pages.
ClassificationScoreboard.title: ClassificationScoreboard

ClassifierOutput.description: What one LLM classifier run must return; anything else is a failed parse.
ClassifierOutput.title: ClassifierOutput

ClassifierScore.description:
One classifier contender on the classifier scoreboard.

A contender that could not be run is not measured: it carries no figure
and no count. A measured one carries the counts behind each figure, all
over the same pages: every page of the scored set.
ClassifierScore.title: ClassifierScore

ClassifierUnscoredCase.description: A file of the page set whose pages all count as wrong for one contender, and why.
ClassifierUnscoredCase.title: ClassifierUnscoredCase

ComparePairs.description:
Response of `GET /api/compare-pairs`: the rows the Compare toggle shows (AD-11).

A setting of `web`, answered as it is. `web` does not know which rows
are built: the SPA asks for the default pair, and uses the fallback pair
when `workflow` refuses a row of the default one as not available.
ComparePairs.title: ComparePairs

DecisionRecorded.description:
Response of `POST /cases/{case_id}/pages/{page_id}/decisions`: the stored decision.

`page_status` is the status the decision left the page in. A repeat of a
decision is answered with the one stored the first time.
DecisionRecorded.title: DecisionRecorded

ExtractionOutput.description: What the extraction model must return for one page; anything else is a failed parse.
ExtractionOutput.title: ExtractionOutput

FailedSearch.description: An eval search that got no answer: counted as a miss for its row.
FailedSearch.title: FailedSearch

Health.description: Response of every service's health and readiness routes.
Health.title: Health

Me.description: Response of `GET /api/me`: the demo role `web` read from the request.
Me.title: Me

PageBoxesQuery.description: Query of `GET /pages/{page_id}/boxes`: an optional offset range into the page text.
PageBoxesQuery.title: PageBoxesQuery

PageDecisionRequest.description:
Request of `POST /api/cases/{case_id}/pages/{page_id}/decisions`.

It names no actor: `web` passes the request's demo role on as the actor
(AD-9), so a browser cannot say who decided.
PageDecisionRequest.title: PageDecisionRequest

PageList.description: Response of `GET /cases/{case_id}/pages`; empty until redaction is done.
PageList.title: PageList

PageQueue.description:
Response of `GET /pages?status=`: the pages across cases that wait in that status.

Oldest waiting first. Pages of a case that belongs to an eval run, that is
failed or completed, or that was started with `stop_after: gate` are left
out. The answer is bounded: `has_more` says that more pages wait than are
listed.
PageQueue.title: PageQueue

PageText.description: Response of `GET /pages/{page_id}/text`: the one stored reading of the page.
PageText.title: PageText

QueuedBy.description: How a page came to wait in the triage queue (AD-7, AD-10).
QueuedBy.title: QueuedBy

QuoteNotFound.description: An expected-fact quote that is no longer in its page's stored text. Never the quote itself.
QuoteNotFound.title: QuoteNotFound

Reason.description: One cited reason: a rule, the facts it was applied to, and its effect.
Reason.title: Reason

ReasonLeak.description: A planted identifier found in a stored `reason`. Never the value itself.
ReasonLeak.title: ReasonLeak

RedactionCommand.description: Request of `POST /cases/{case_id}/redaction`; the key is the `case_id` in the path.
RedactionCommand.title: RedactionCommand

RedactionLeak.description: A planted identifier found in a stored page text. Never the value itself.
RedactionLeak.title: RedactionLeak

RedactionScoreboard.description:
The file `redaction.json`: whether redaction left a planted identifier behind.

And what it took away beside them: the expected-fact quotes that the
stored page text no longer holds.
RedactionScoreboard.title: RedactionScoreboard

RetrievalRowScore.description:
One ladder row on the retrieval scoreboard.

A row that answered "not available" is not measured: it is listed with
what it is and carries no figure and no count. A measured row carries
the counts behind each figure; a figure is null when its count is 0.
RetrievalRowScore.title: RetrievalRowScore

RetrievalScoreboard.description: The file `retrieval.json`: every ladder row, scored on the same cases.
RetrievalScoreboard.title: RetrievalScoreboard

RetrieverPair.description: Two ladder rows whose verdict runs on one case are shown side by side.
RetrieverPair.title: RetrieverPair

RouteDetail.description: Detail of `page.routed`: the status the gate gave the page, and the threshold it used.
RouteDetail.title: RouteDetail

RuleReadQuery.description: Query of `GET /rules/{rule_id}`; without the parameter the `smart` chunk is returned.
RuleReadQuery.title: RuleReadQuery

RunStepQuery.description:
Query of `GET /verdict-runs/{verdict_run_id}/steps`; every field is optional.

`tool` and `rule_id` narrow the run's steps as they narrow a case's.
`tool` names one of the three tools: a step that asked for a tool that
does not exist is listed only when no tool is named.
`after_step_no` is the cursor: the last step number seen, so that the
steps beyond one answer's limit can be read.
RunStepQuery.title: RunStepQuery

ScoreboardRun.description: When and where a bake-off run was made.
ScoreboardRun.title: ScoreboardRun

SearchRequest.description: Request of `POST /searches`; the result is not stored.
SearchRequest.title: SearchRequest

Service.description: The seven services, by Dapr app id (AD-1).
Service.title: Service

StartCaseOptions.description:
What a case may be started with; every option is optional (settings fill the gaps).

Also the body of `web`'s `POST /api/cases/{case_id}/start`. It names no
actor: `web` passes the request's demo role on as the actor (AD-9), so a
browser cannot say who started the case.
StartCaseOptions.title: StartCaseOptions

StartCaseRequest.description:
Request of `POST /cases/{case_id}/start`: the options, and who asks.

`workflow` refuses a start that names no demo role.
StartCaseRequest.title: StartCaseRequest

StatedFigure.description: A figure the runner cannot measure: stated by hand, with where it comes from.
StatedFigure.title: StatedFigure

StepOutcome.description: How one tool call of the verdict agent ended (AD-15).
StepOutcome.title: StepOutcome

StopAfter.description: Where a case may be told to stop early (AD-17: the classifier bake-off).
StopAfter.title: StopAfter

SystemReason.description: Verdict reasons that need no citation (AD-15).
SystemReason.title: SystemReason

TriagePage.description:
One page that waits for the underwriter, with what the classifier said of it.

`web` composes it: the page from `workflow`'s queue, the reading from
`classification`, for the classifier the case was started with. The four
fields of the reading are null together when it could not be read; the
page can be decided all the same.
TriagePage.title: TriagePage

TriageQueue.description: Response of `GET /api/triage`: the pages that wait for the underwriter, oldest first.
TriageQueue.title: TriageQueue

UncheckedReasons.description: A file whose stored reasons could not be read for one contender: nothing of them was checked.
UncheckedReasons.title: UncheckedReasons

UnclassifiedPage.description: A page with a failed result, or none, for one contender: it counts as wrong.
UnclassifiedPage.title: UnclassifiedPage

UnscoredCase.description: A case that counts as wrong for every row, and why.
UnscoredCase.title: UnscoredCase

UploadedCase.description:
Response of `POST /api/cases`: the case `intake` created.

It carries no status: the case is started by a call of its own
(`POST /api/cases/{case_id}/start`), and `workflow` reports its status
from then on (`GET /api/cases/{case_id}/progress`).
UploadedCase.title: UploadedCase

VerdictDetail.description:
Detail of `verdict.suggested`: the retriever configuration the run was made with (AD-15).

A case gets one run per configuration it was started with, and each is
an event of its own: the detail says which.
VerdictDetail.title: VerdictDetail

VerdictOutput.description: What the verdict agent must return; `verdict`'s domain code finishes it (AD-15).
VerdictOutput.title: VerdictOutput

VerdictRun.description: One verdict run as read by `web`: always a suggestion, never a decision.
VerdictRun.title: VerdictRun

VerdictRunList.description:
Response of `GET /cases/{case_id}/verdict-runs`: the case's runs, oldest first.

The answer is bounded: `has_more` says that the case has more runs than
are listed.
VerdictRunList.title: VerdictRunList

VerdictRunRequested.description:
The requested run's state; the run itself is read from `verdict`.

`running` while the run is under way, then `done` or `failed`.
VerdictRunRequested.title: VerdictRunRequested

WordBox.description: One word of the page text and where it sits on the page.
WordBox.title: WordBox
